newsitem.title: CROATIA: French group takes control of Croatian lift maker.
newsitem.headline: French group takes control of Croatian lift maker.

text.p: French holding group United Technologies Holdings SA bought 80 percent of Croatia's lift maker Rade Koncar-Inzinjering Vertikalnog Transporta (IVT) for 3.3 million German marks, IVT told Reuters.
"We expect an influx of foreign capital which means new technology and the possibility to grant loans to our customers," IVT's general manager Ivan Kotarski said.
United Technologies owns the world's largest lift and escalator producer OTIS GesmbH which conducted the purchase, mediated by Zagreb I.C.F. brokerage on Tuesday.

Rade Koncar IVT was fully privatised in 1992 after it separated from the still mostly state-owned Rade Koncar electrical concern. Its main business is elevator servicing, but it hopes to expand production, given diminishing competition, Kotarski said.
"Now that (competitor) Koncar Dizala has gone bankrupt, we expect to bring more lifts into the Croatian market," Kotarski said.
He added that the company, which employs some 200 workers accross Croatia, sold 81.9 percent or 5,480 shares of its portfolio, each worth 500 German marks or 1,800 kuna, to United Technologies.
